properties.name: The `undated` mention was removed from add_change_event's TOOL DESCRIPTION after skill_lint refused it at 1901 of a 1500-character budget. The BEHAVIOUR is unchanged and still tested; the explanation now lives where it was already fuller — the `detected_at` parameter doc, and the `undated` note the reply itself carries. That placement is this project's own stated preference: a note read at the moment of the mistake beats a paragraph in a description nobody re-reads. The design HOLDS.
